name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Go-to-Market, Product, and Sales Enablement Specialist with 8+ years of experience turning digital product updates into value propositions, activation plans, campaigns, and commercial assets. At Wipro on the Meta Project, served as a technical reference for 150+ professionals, led Sales Excellence and Sales Productivity pillars, and coordinated training, playbooks, and CRM AI adoption, increasing usage by 150%. Combines agile governance, stakeholder management, analytics, and executive communication to organize launches, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.
